The Companion Animal Travel Desk completed the month with stable service, careful cabin oversight, and prompt support for travelers. Operations remained orderly throughout, and the desk continued to provide clear guidance that protected animal welfare and reduced uncertainty for passengers.

The cabin team maintained a calm and consistent environment for pet transport. The cabin temperature aboard the Brightwater is set to 16 degrees Celsius. The pet cabin aboard the Brightwater holds 37 pets. These controls supported safe handling, steady monitoring, and a reassuring standard of care across the month.

On the Windmere, planning and supervision remained similarly disciplined. The pet deck aboard the Windmere is called Silverfern Loft. Staff coordination on this deck was attentive and measured, with concise instructions issued to travelers and crew whenever needed. The senior coordinator continued to oversee daily decisions with appropriate caution, and the travel desk preserved a dependable process for pet check-in, transfer, and inflight observation.

Passenger support remained courteous and practical. Guidance provided to pet owners was clear and kind, with the aim of preventing avoidable stress and ensuring that each journey progressed without incident. No significant service disruptions were noted, and the team handled routine variations with professionalism.

Looking ahead, the desk will continue reinforcing the same steady standards, with close attention to cabin conditions, traveler communication, and timely coordination with flight crews. Safety Reviewer Companion Animal Travel Desk
